acceptanceCriteria: A failing go build in each dogfood script prints the compiler error tail and keeps the full log path (test or retained transcript)
All four scripts build with the same flags
body: Observed 2026-10-18 on origin/main: script/dogfood-change.sh:31, dogfood-check.sh:39,50, dogfood-finish.sh:75,86 and dogfood-batch-check.sh:27 run `go build ... 2> /dev/null` and on failure print only a REFUSE code such as current-tree-corvint-build-failed. The compiler error is lost; the lane must rerun go build by hand to see it. Expected: write the build log under the evidence directory and print its tail on failure. Also: dogfood-change.sh builds without -trimpath while the other three use it, so the binaries are not interchangeable (related to V1-1639 rebuild cost).
title: dogfood scripts discard go build output (2> /dev/null), so a build failure shows only current-tree-corvint-build-failed
